title: Per-facility CO2 emission record
description: Phase 7 of NOVEL_METHODOLOGY_PROPOSAL.md: the interchange format this project exports for downstream integration (e.g. an external visualization platform). One record per facility. Every field that represents a modeled/estimated quantity carries an explicit validation_status alongside it -- this schema deliberately does not let a consumer read a number without also seeing whether it has been validated against real ground truth, only against another satellite-inferred benchmark, or not validated at all. See NOVEL_METHODOLOGY_PROPOSAL.md for the full methodology and honesty caveats behind every field.

facility_id.description: Stable identifier, currently the same as 'name' (this project's internal facility name).

activity_prob_mean.description: Mean plant-classifier confidence across this facility's monthly tiles, inference-only (model not retrained on this facility).

exhaustive_lofo_recall.description: This facility's own leave-one-facility-out recall when held out during Track A's exhaustive LOFO evaluation (69.1% mean across all facilities). Null if this facility wasn't part of that evaluation.

validation_status.description: Whether this facility's detection was evaluated by holding it out entirely during training (the rigorous test), not just inference on an already-seen facility.

track_b.description: Physics-based IME mass-balance CO2 emission-rate estimate from OCO-3.

month_stratified.description: Whether the near/background comparison was restricted to shared months (fixes a real seasonal-sampling-bias bug found for one facility; see PROJECT_RESEARCH_DOCUMENTATION.md Sec 12.7).

corrected_q_t_per_year.description: Leave-one-out cross-validated corrected estimate, ONLY meaningful for the N=17 facilities in q_correction_model.py's own fit -- this is not a general-purpose correction function applicable to arbitrary new facilities without refitting.

correction_significant.description: False as of this export: the correction's improvement has a bootstrap 95% CI that includes zero at N=17 (see NOVEL_METHODOLOGY_PROPOSAL.md Sec 12.5) -- real and directionally consistent, but not yet statistically significant.

validation_status.description: Whether this facility has a matched India CEA CO2 Baseline Database entry (real, non-satellite, fuel-consumption-based ground truth) -- as opposed to only a Climate TRACE benchmark comparison.

climate_trace_comparison.description: Independent benchmark, NOT ground truth (Climate TRACE is itself a satellite-thermal-proxy estimator, unvalidated for India).

plume.description: Gaussian plume hotspot/density map (Briggs/Pasquill-Gifford), calibrated to track_b.raw_estimate.q_t_per_year.

validated.description: Always false as of this export. Two independent robustness checks (random-sector null baseline, per-overpass day-matched wind) found the plume's predicted spatial orientation does not reliably align with real OCO-3 spatial data for the large majority of facilities tested -- see NOVEL_METHODOLOGY_PROPOSAL.md Sec 11-12. This map is a physics-consistent VISUALIZATION calibrated to a validated total mass flux, not a validated spatial prediction, and downstream consumers must not present it as one.

grid_reference.description: Path to the .npz grid file (east_km, north_km, grid in kg/m^3), relative to this project's data/ directory.

temporal.description: Monthly CO2 signal shape, where enough OCO-3 coverage exists.

absolute_values_comparable_to_annual.description: Always false. Monthly Q values from a smaller subsample are systematically biased relative to the annual scalar due to L_eff's sqrt(n) scaling (see NOVEL_METHODOLOGY_PROPOSAL.md Sec 12.6) -- only relative month-to-month comparison within this facility is meaningful.

monsoon_sampling_gap_caveat.description: Months 7/8/10 have no usable data for ANY facility in this dataset, likely an OCO-3 monsoon-cloud-cover retrieval gap, not a genuine emissions pattern.
